# Breathing Dots attribution

This background is a framework-free Canvas adaptation of the breathing-wave
concept demonstrated in `mattrossman/breathing-dots-tutorial`.

- Source: https://github.com/mattrossman/breathing-dots-tutorial
- Original article: https://tympanus.net/codrops/2020/12/17/recreating-a-dave-whyte-animation-in-react-three-fiber/
- License: MIT

The CASINO IN adaptation preserves the radial rounded-square-wave movement
while limiting dot count, pixel ratio, frame rate, and offscreen rendering for
the Flask dashboard.
